verdict: SIMPLE q-ASKEY PRODUCT FORM REFUTED (scope (a)). The binding generating function Ĝ(z)=Σ S(m) z^m/N(m) is NOT a closed-form q-Pochhammer product ∏(z qᵃ;q)_∞^{cᵃ}: in BOTH the symmetric [m]_q! and the q-Askey (q;q)_m normalizations, L_m·(1−qᵐ) retains residual cyclotomic factors (not Laurent), consistent with the not-low-order-q-holonomic result (PR #2899 Stages 3–4). POSITIVE family map stands: the binding side is the q-HERMITE / Rogers–Szegő MOMENT sequence and W_λ = d_q²/D² is the same family's PLANCHEREL MEASURE; their bridge is the three-term recurrence / orthogonality (FollowsRogersSzego), not a product GF. 𝔙 framing: the binding side is Re 𝔙 = 𝔈_bind (bar-even cosh) of the complex-volume observable 𝔙 = Vol + i·CS; Im 𝔙 = 𝔔_β is the bar-odd sinh c_k Habiro element. The q-Askey q = e^η cosh/sinh grading IS the Re/Im split — so the binding q-Hermite moment describes Re 𝔙, and the full 𝔙 is the COMPLEX q-Hermite/Askey object whose real part is binding, imaginary part Q_β.
